// Positive control (#5170): a function anywhere in src/ that prints a verdict-shaped payload AND
// assigns the process exit itself, without declaring it from the verdict through the exit seam.
import { output } from './io.cjs';

export function cmdFixtureReport(passed: boolean, raw: boolean): void {
  output({ passed, errors: [] }, raw);
  if (!passed) process.exitCode = 1;
}
